race.title: Coral Racing Club Intermediate Handicap Hurdle (Reg' As The Gerry Feilden) (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: A good-looking renewal of the Gerry Feilden. IDAHO SUN was seen to better effect than subsequent Supreme third Mydaddypaddy when accounting for him in the Grade 1 Formby at Aintree when last seen, but that form still makes him look well treated from an opening mark in the early 140s, so there's every reason to believe he can maintain his unbeaten record over hurdles. Mondo Man is well worth another chance given the strength of his Imperial Cup win, with The Mighty Celt completing the shortlist. IDAHO SUN (IRE) MONDO MAN THE MIGHTY CELT (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Idaho Sun (13/8), Minella Yoga (7/2), La Conquiere (11/2), Mossy Fen Road (8/1), Mondo Man (10/1), The Mighty Celt (10/1), Our Boy Stan (10/1), White Noise (16/1), Klycot (16/1)
